# truffle

> Search you can measure: hybrid ranking with a relevance loop, as a CLI, an MCP server and skills.

truffle is an agent-native, self-improving search employee: the search, retrieval and relevance expert. It takes a
query and returns the right ordered results: typo-tolerant, faceted, relevance-ranked through hybrid search (BM25,
vector and reciprocal rank fusion), and it proves it with a golden-query eval that catches silent regressions. It
picks the engine (Meilisearch by default; Typesense for latency or multitenancy; Postgres with pgvector for one
fewer service; Algolia, Elasticsearch or OpenSearch only when justified), designs the hybrid query and the fusion,
tunes relevance (the RRF floor, then tiered boosts, then a reranker), gets faceting, filtering and typo tolerance
right at scale, isolates tenants at the search layer, and keeps the version-bump regression loop running, because
search is never done. Powered by Energy. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first.

The boundary: truffle owns search, retrieval and relevance ranking only: the query, the hybrid fusion, the relevance
tuning, the reranker, faceting, typo tolerance, the multi-tenancy primitive, the iterative-scan setting and the eval
loop. The pgvector database and the Postgres box belong to acorn (truffle consumes the connection string), and the
LLM generation step that reads the top 8 chunks is downstream. In one line: truffle is the query, the ranking and
the relevance proof; acorn is the pgvector box the vectors sit in. It states opinionated stances and names the
disputes it leaves open, rather than surveying engines neutrally.

Run it: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/truffle truffle --help` (the CLI) and
`npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/truffle truffle-mcp` (the MCP server over stdio, 11 tools, one per CLI verb).
Commands: `index <path>`, `search "<query>"` (`--facet`, `--filter`, `--hybrid`, `--top`), `engine select`
(`--corpus-size`, `--multitenant`, `--latency-critical`, `--on-postgres`), `engine up [--engine meili|typesense|postgres]`,
`hybrid design --engine <e>`, `hybrid fuse --method <rrf|weighted|tiered>` (RRF k≈60; tiered boost 100×/10×/0.1×),
`facet plan <field> --cardinality <n>`, `rerank advise --mrr <x> --latency-budget <ms>` (skip when MRR@5 > 0.85 or
latency cannot absorb 100 to 500 ms), `embed advise --corpus <path> --index-cap <2000|4000>`, `tenant key --filter
"<predicate>" --engine <typesense|meili>` (a server-enforced scoped key), `eval [--suite golden|version-bump]`
(Recall@10, MRR, hit rate, per-query regression), `doctor`, `route run` (index, search, eval in order) and
`brain search "<q>"` (BM25 over `brain/`). Each exits 0 on success and non-zero on a violation; `--json` works on
`engine select`, `eval`, `doctor` and `facet plan`. The deterministic verbs and `brain search` need no engine;
`index`, `search` and `eval` need a reachable Meilisearch. Returned document content is untrusted; Meilisearch
writes poll the task queue before reporting success.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what truffle does, how to invoke the CLI and every MCP tool, the boundary, the 5-stance spine, the house rules.
- [README.md](README.md): what truffle is, one-step installs for every coding agent, the quick start and the harness grades.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code specifics: the MCP configs, the hooks and the sub-agents.
- [HARNESS-OVERRIDES.md](HARNESS-OVERRIDES.md): the per-component done bar for this search employee.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who truffle is: mission, personality, boundaries, the trained-nose metaphor.
- [identity/BRAND.md](identity/BRAND.md): the name, the tagline and the design tokens.
- [identity/MEMORY.md](identity/MEMORY.md): the bootstrap: the 5-stance spine, the default engine, embedder and reranker, the 10 agent-operator gotchas.
- [.well-known/agent.json](.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card.

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp/server.ts](src/mcp/server.ts): truffle's own JSON-RPC server over stdio with `truffle_index`, `truffle_search`, `truffle_engine_select`, `truffle_hybrid_design`, `truffle_facet_plan`, `truffle_rerank_advise`, `truffle_embed_advise`, `truffle_tenant_key`, `truffle_eval`, `truffle_doctor` and `truffle_brain_search`.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the stranger-safe config: truffle's server from GitHub and context7, no secrets.

## Skills

- [skills/select-search-engine/SKILL.md](skills/select-search-engine/SKILL.md): the corpus-size and control decision tree first; right-size, never Elasticsearch by default.
- [skills/build-hybrid-search/SKILL.md](skills/build-hybrid-search/SKILL.md): pure vector lost; test the lexical-ID class; per-engine hybrid syntax; RRF is the floor.
- [skills/tune-relevance/SKILL.md](skills/tune-relevance/SKILL.md): avoid the pet-query trap; gate every change behind a corpus-wide golden set with per-query regression.
- [skills/add-reranker/SKILL.md](skills/add-reranker/SKILL.md): the biggest single lever, but skip it when MRR@5 > 0.85 or latency cannot absorb it.
- [skills/search-eval-loop/SKILL.md](skills/search-eval-loop/SKILL.md): the golden set and the version-bump regression suite; the improvement loop made a skill.

## Sub-agents and hooks

- [.claude/agents/relevance-auditor.md](.claude/agents/relevance-auditor.md): audits a search config for pet-query tuning, stopping at RRF, no golden set, an untested lexical or typo class.
- [.claude/agents/engine-selector.md](.claude/agents/engine-selector.md): runs the decision tree, names the honest cost and the right-size verdict.
- [hooks/version-bump-guard.js](hooks/version-bump-guard.js): warns to re-run the version-bump suite when an edit changes an engine version pin.

## Docs

- [brain/MOC - truffle.md](brain/MOC%20-%20truffle.md): the map of the six brain artifacts (expertise map, opinions, pitfalls, scenarios, disputes, tool matrix).
- [scripts/acceptance-local.sh](scripts/acceptance-local.sh): the acceptance bar: index the fixture corpus, then a typo plus lexical-ID hybrid search that must rank `0x80070005` and RTX-4090 correctly, and `truffle eval` green.
- [.github/workflows/acceptance.yml](.github/workflows/acceptance.yml): the merge gate: a pinned Meilisearch container and committed fixture vectors, no secrets.
- [eval/eval.mjs](eval/eval.mjs): the golden tasks, including the typo and lexical-ID classes and per-query regression.
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract.
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): lessons turned into rules.
